info.title: MyMail API
info.description: Manage domains, mailboxes and aliases, read mail and send it, give AI agents their own inboxes, and work with tasks, projects, docs, contacts and deals. Agent keys (created with an agent) act only as that agent: they read its threads as JSON and send within its caps and approval rules. The MCP server is at /api/v1/mcp. Webhooks are signed with the Standard Webhooks spec: verify with any Standard Webhooks library and your endpoint's whsec_ secret.

A live stream of the agent's events as SSE. Each event's `id` is its sequence number: reconnect with the `Last-Event-ID` header (any SSE client does this) to resume without gaps. The server closes the stream after `timeout` seconds (default 300); reconnect then.
